cpp-template-inherited-base-signature.item: - The inherited traversal calls `cpp_direct_base_types` (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:3023`), which reads `unit.signature()`, or source text when `unit.signature()` is `None` (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:3211`). Class `CodeUnit`s are constructed with `scope.template_signature` as their identity `signature` field, the value `CodeUnit::signature` returns (`src/analyzer/cpp/declarations.rs:317`, `src/analyzer/model.rs:355`). That scope field is assigned from `cpp_template_signature` (`src/analyzer/cpp/declarations.rs:207`), which returns the template parameter head; the class base clause is not part of its text (`src/analyzer/cpp/declarations.rs:1317`).
cpp-template-inherited-base-signature.why: Every relation element is kept; the edited line states the identity-signature flow and that the template head excludes the base clause.

php-indexed-write-reenters-current-rhs.item: - `collection_element_type_fq_name` calls `infer_indexed_local_element_type` with `before_byte` set to `collection.start_byte()` and a `resolve_value` callback that calls `instance_receiver_type_fq_name_inner` (`crates/bifrost-php/src/graph/syntax.rs:1548`, `crates/bifrost-php/src/graph/syntax.rs:1553`). `infer_indexed_local_element_type` walks the nodes of the enclosing local scope (`crates/bifrost-php/src/graph/syntax.rs:1393`), skips a node when its start byte is at or after `before_byte`, with no comparison of an assignment's end byte (`crates/bifrost-php/src/graph/syntax.rs:1401`), and calls `resolve_value(right)` for each visited assignment whose left side subscripts the same variable (`crates/bifrost-php/src/graph/syntax.rs:1421`). The visited assignments include one that encloses the collection node passed in (its start byte precedes the collection's).
php-indexed-write-reenters-current-rhs.why: The 'even when the assignment encloses the current read' condition becomes a separate, unconditional existence claim, so a reader must combine sentences to get it. The line also adds a new call edge and a start-byte explanation.

added: explicit call edge collection_element_type_fq_name -> infer_indexed_local_element_type
added: unconditional claim that the visited assignments include one enclosing the collection node
added: reason: the enclosing assignment's start byte precedes the collection's

unproven-override-family-certifies-empty.item: - `MemberFamilyAnswer::is_proven` compares the outcome with `Proven` (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/member_family.rs:146`). The hierarchy helper collects `ImplementedBy`/`OverriddenBy` targets when `is_proven` is true, constructs an empty vector when it is false, and then returns `Some(targets)` (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/workspace_oracle/dispatch.rs:945`).
